infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NRYN requires microphone access to record voice meetings and generate automated Minutes of Meeting (MoM).
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: NRYN requires Bluetooth access to connect to your Garmin smartwatch and stream live health telemetry.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: NRYN requires Bluetooth access to communicate with smartwatches.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NRYN requires camera access to measure heart rate pulse and scan nutrition plates.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: NRYN reads steps, heart rate, and sleep data to optimize your marathon training plan.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: NRYN syncs training workouts to Apple Health.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow NRYN to access your microphone to record voice meetings.
